output.summary: KEP-585 introduced RuntimeClass, a cluster-scoped resource that surfaces container runtime properties to the control plane and is assigned to pods via a runtimeClass PodSpec field. The KEP is recorded as implemented and at stable stage, with GA targeted for Kubernetes 1.20.
output.rationale: The design addresses growing interest in running multiple runtimes (e.g. sandboxes like Kata containers and gVisor) in one cluster, requiring a way to select among them and surface their properties. Graduation to stable was gated on adding graduation criteria and a test plan to the KEP, and on conformance tests for the GA API, which were completed after a code freeze exception. The sources do not state a single explicit rationale for the stable promotion beyond the feature being in production use and needing GA status.

alternatives.option: Keep RuntimeClass in beta without promoting to stable
alternatives.why_not: The sources show the 1.20 plan was to go GA; a maintainer confirmed 'Yep, still planned for v1.20' and the enhancements lead asked the KEP to add stable graduation criteria, but no source explains a rejection of this path.

alternatives.option: Revert RuntimeClass GA from the 1.20 release due to missing conformance tests
alternatives.why_not: Discussed by release team as a possibility if the conformance tests were not in place; the sources say a PR merged (kubernetes/kubernetes#96551) and promotion to conformance was pending, so the revert was not the path taken.

alternatives.option: Make a Windows/OS reserved label part of the scope
alternatives.why_not: Raised in review; the sources say it stays in the non-goals section for this graduation effort, with no other label-reservation effort identified.

evidence.quote: `RuntimeClass` is a new cluster-scoped resource that surfaces container runtime properties to the control plane.
Yep, still planned for v1.20. See https://docs.google.com/document/d/17nROj6ayPsUpx09mhLrzOkRLgo-8sn6Vgfyy-gmyuo4/edit#heading=h.3qoppsm7jdvw for planning.
This will need graduation criteria (you have alpha beta, but not stable) and a test plan. Please update and merge the KEP by tomorrow's (October 6th) enhancements freeze.
As an update: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/96551 has merged and we are waiting for sufficient runs to promote to conformance via another pr
Since this is now GA and the KEP has an implemented status, you can close this tracking issue.
